items.title: Councillor J. Gowing, Re: Facilities Strategic Plan
notes:
In response to Committee, W. Steffler did ask that consideration also be given to scope of this request. Staff would return to Council with a report that would define scope and financial impact. W. Steffler estimated the work would take 6-12 months.
In response to Committee W. Steffler did confirm that a report can come back to Council to allow Council to make informed decisions at the same time as budget for 2027.
W. Steffler also confirmed that a Facilities Strategic Plan differs from asset management work because Facilities focuses more on how the space is used, not in the condition of the space. It was also confirmed that this work would function better as its own plan and not as part of asset management.

motions.item_title: Councillor J. Gowing, Re: Facilities Strategic Plan
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo direct Facilities staff to explore the development of a Facilities Strategic Plan focused on the following five components: A complete inventory of all corporate facilities, including current usage, functional capacity, and condition; An analysis of operating and maintenance requirements and associated costs across all corporate facilities; A five- to ten-year capital outlook identifying required investments, lifecycle needs, and projected financial impacts; A review of accommodation standards and policies to support facilities planning and a demand analysis to clarify space needs; An evaluation of optimization opportunities, including consolidation, repurposing, or alternative service delivery options to ensure efficient and cost-effective use of corporate space; And that staff report back to Council with the findings, options, and recommended next steps.
motions.text_html:
That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo direct Facilities staff to explore the development of a Facilities Strategic Plan focused on the following five components:

  1. A complete inventory of all corporate facilities, including current usage, functional capacity, and condition;
  2. An analysis of operating and maintenance requirements and associated costs across all corporate facilities;
  3. A five- to ten-year capital outlook identifying required investments, lifecycle needs, and projected financial impacts;
  4. A review of accommodation standards and policies to support facilities planning and a demand analysis to clarify space needs;
  5. An evaluation of optimization opportunities, including consolidation, repurposing, or alternative service delivery options to ensure efficient and cost-effective use of corporate space;

And that staff report back to Council with the findings, options, and recommended next steps.

motions.item_title: Councillor D. Craig, Re: Continued Election of Regional Chair
motions.text: Therefore Be It Resolved That The Council of the Region of Waterloo formally requests the Province of Ontario to affirm and support the continued election of the Regional Chair by the voters of the Region of Waterloo or appointed by Region of Waterloo Council, And that the province be requested not to impose or advance legislation that would replaced an elected chair with a provincially appointed position, And that the province be further requested to consult with the Region of Waterloo and its area municipalities prior to any proposed changes to the regional governance structure, And that a copy of this motion be forwarded to: The Premier of Ontario; The Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing; The Minister of Finance; All members of Provincial Parliament representing Waterloo Region; and The Association of Municipalities of Ontario (AMO).
motions.text_html:
Therefore Be It Resolved That

The Council of the Region of Waterloo formally requests the Province of Ontario to affirm and support the continued election of the Regional Chair by the voters of the Region of Waterloo or appointed by Region of Waterloo Council,

And that the province be requested not to impose or advance legislation that would replaced an elected chair with a provincially appointed position,

And that the province be further requested to consult with the Region of Waterloo and its area municipalities prior to any proposed changes to the regional governance structure,

And that a copy of this motion be forwarded to:

  1. The Premier of Ontario;
  2. The Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing;
  3. The Minister of Finance;
  4. All members of Provincial Parliament representing Waterloo Region; and
  5. The Association of Municipalities of Ontario (AMO).
